item.author: Carole King (@carolekingofficial.bsky.social)
item.description:
"Goin' Back" was written by Gerry Goffin and Carole King in 1966.
The song was recorded that year by Dusty Springfield, and was a top ten hit on the UK Singles Chart.
The Byrds, Marianne Faithfull, the Pretenders, Diana Ross, Phil Collins, and Carole also covered the song, among many others.
